Enterprise SIP RFC 3840 Automata Bot-Loop Breaker & RFC 3841 Caller-Prefs Guard

🎉 P900 · 95TH FAQ · 895 TESTS

❌ Unguarded RFC 3840/3841: Bot-to-Bot Loop & 480 Starvation
1. Missing RFC 3840 ;automata & Infinite Bot-to-Bot Banter Loop
• Outbound AI Voice Agent calls customer with iOS/Android AI Call Screener.
• Acoustic AMD fails because AI screener uses natural streaming TTS.
• Both LLMs politely ask each other to clarify intent for 120+ turns,
burning 7,000+ GPU & PSTN minutes/day on circular machine chatter!
Result: 45-Minute Infinite Bot-to-Bot Loops & Runaway GPU/Carrier Bills
2. RFC 3841 Accept-Contact ;require;explicit Queue Starvation
• Warm transfer sets Accept-Contact: *;language="yue";require;explicit.
• 50 idle human agents use standard SIP desk phones that do not
explicitly advertise custom feature tags in REGISTER Contact headers.
• Proxy sets q=0.0 for all 50 phones and drops call with SIP 480!
Result: 100% Human-Escalation Transfer Failure Despite Idle Agent Pool
✅ RFC 3840 Loop Breaker (P899) & RFC 3841 Priority Guard (P900 🎉)
P899 · RFC 3840 ;automata Tagging & [1, 3]-Turn Bot Loop Breaker
• Mandates Contact ;automata on all outbound/inbound AI voice legs.
• Detects remote ;automata / actor="msg-taker" or call-screener intent.
• Clamps Bot-to-Automata turn ceiling to [1, 3] turns, delivers concise
message summary, and sends clean BYE (0 infinite Bot-to-Bot loops)!
clampedInfiniteBotToBotLoopCalls = 0 · Bot-to-Bot Turns ∈ [1, 3]
P900 🎉 · RFC 3841 Anti-Starvation & [100, 1000] milli-q Priority Guard
• Enforces Reject-Contact: *;automata on human-escalation transfers.
• Strips starving ;require;explicit flags when strict match set is empty.
• Clamps Contact routing priority to [100, 1000] integer milli-q units
(q = 0.100 .. 1.000) for 100% deterministic non-zero human fallback!
clampedStarvedHumanEscalationOrMisroutedBotCalls = 0 · milli-q ∈ [100, 1000]
